headline: FEMINIST 🗣️ ICON Gloria Steinem DIES 🪦 at 92 🌹
text:
GLORIA 🕊️ STEINEM the absolute LEGENDARY 🗣️ trailblazing FEMINIST 🪩 who basically BIRTHED 💥 the women's LIBERATION 🗽 movement across AMERICA 🇺🇸 has peacefully PASSED 🪦 away at the RIPE 🍑 age of 92 in her New York City 🏙️ home surrounded by everyone who straight up ADORED 💞 her!! Her foundation dropped the news on INSTAGRAM 📸 saying she went out SMOOTH 🧈 like a true queen 👑 after decades of SLAYING 🗡️ sexism left and right!! This woman was out here co-founding the WOMEN'S 🧘‍♀️ Action Alliance over FIFTY 5️⃣0️⃣ years ago to fight every form of BS 💩 that tried to hold ladies back and she NEVER 🛑 stopped grinding for that EQUALITY ⚖️ glow up!! Bro she got the whole scene so WET 💧 with inspiration that even now her ripple EFFECTS 🌊 are still hitting different generations HARD 🍆 like a feminist aftershock!!

She kicked things off as a journalist 📝 in the Big Apple 🍎 then co-created Ms. MAGAZINE 📰 one of the first rags that actually talked about REAL 🧠 women's issues instead of just housekeeping 🧹 and beauty 💄 routines!! In the SEVENTIES 7️⃣0️⃣s Gloria was the loudest VOICE 📢 pushing reproductive RIGHTS 🛡️ hard after she herself went through an ILLEGAL 🚫 abortion in London at just 22 years old!! She popped bottles 🥂 when Roe v Wade dropped in 73 granting that constitutional green light 🚦 only to watch it get YANKED 🔄 away nearly half a century later what a wild ROLLERCOASTER 🎢 of a ride she took us on!! This queen also campaigned for same-sex MARRIAGE 💒 equal pay 💰 and against the death penalty ⚰️ plus female genital mutilation she was out here collecting CAUSES 📋 like they were limited edition TRADING 🃏 cards!!

Born on March 25 1934 in Toledo Ohio this icon had a ROUGH 🪨 childhood only hitting full-time school at age 12 can you even IMAGINE 🧠 the grit baked into her from jump!! After college she jetted to India on a scholarship and spent two whole years helping village women organize NON-VIOLENT ✊ protests against government policies which lit the FIRE 🔥 under her grassroots ACTIVISM 🏴‍☠️ soul!! Then she slid into New York in the early 60s as a freelance writer and her BIG 💥 break was that EXPOSÉ 🔎 on Playboy Bunny working conditions that had everyone GASPING 😮 before she leveled up to columnist at New York Magazine and founded Ms. in 1972!! For YEARS she said nah to marriage until she finally tied the knot in 2000 with David Bale Christian Bale's dad who sadly passed three years later but when asked why she switched up she hit them with the iconic "I didn't change MARRIAGE changed" 🥂 line!!

In 2013 Obama hooked her up with the Presidential Medal of Freedom the highest civilian HONOR 🏅 in the US because obviously she EARNED 🏆 that smoke!! Her foundation says she kept grinding for equality until the VERY 🛑 end with her greatest gift being the way she LISTENED 👂 made folks feel seen and heard while dropping words actions and examples that gave permission to be your truest self!! Gloria lived that independent SPIRIT 👻 always curious with a killer sense of HUMOUR 😂 and spent her last years in community writing while hosting these Talking Circles at home that are gonna keep going strong!! Her house was a straight up HUB 🏠 for social justice movements and she's leaving behind a forthcoming book An Unexpected Life hoping it creates ripple effects for generations to come what a final GIFT 🎁 from the ultimate activist DADDY 🐺 Gloria!!

Tributes poured in THICK 💦 on Thursday from writers feminists and heavy hitters like Meghan Markle who called her friend and mentor while posting pics and saying privately she was even BETTER than you could imagine!! Meghan revealed Gloria spent Thanksgiving with her family introduced her to besties loved their kids with her whole heart gave advice over tea with unmatched cheekiness and wit now she wears that bracelet saying "we are linked not ranked" with straight PRIDE 🏳️‍🌈!! Hillary Clinton weighed in too calling Steinem one of the main ARCHITECTS 🏗️ of women's equality tearing down obstacles so young women could chase their talents and hard work!! Clinton told CBS that Gloria was an optimist at heart with activism rooted in that moral choice she made every single DAY 🌅 truly the gift that kept on giving!!
